games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: In Planning the Garden, why do the friends build a small fence?
choices: To water the garden every day.
rounds.explanation: The plan states the purpose of the fence straight after the word to.

rounds.prompt: Which question about a past journey is written correctly?
choices: Where did you travelled last week?
Where did you travel last week?
rounds.answer: Where did you travel last week?
rounds.explanation: Past questions need the helping word did, and after did the verb goes back to its base form.

rounds.prompt: Which of these things did the class do first when they made the wall?
choices: They discussed the design and colours.
They began to build the wall.
rounds.explanation: The story marks this step with First, and the other three follow it with Then, Next and later.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: In A Busy Saturday, what did Adam remove from the yard?
choices: Adam removed the old sticks from the yard.
She offered to help him carry his heavy basket.
The class started to build a new reading wall.
rounds.answer: Adam removed the old sticks from the yard.
rounds.explanation: The recount names Adam and the old sticks he took away.

rounds.prompt: How many steps are in the garden plan, and what is step two?
choices: She offered to help him carry his heavy basket.
They found a hole covered by stones and dry leaves.
There are four steps, and step two is to build a small fence.
rounds.answer: There are four steps, and step two is to build a small fence.
rounds.explanation: The speaker marks the steps with First, Then, After that and Finally.

rounds.prompt: What special project did Teacher Yasmin start in the school garden?
choices: The sign said: “We built this wall to share words and protect dreams.”
The class started to build a new reading wall.
There are four steps, and step two is to build a small fence.
rounds.answer: The class started to build a new reading wall.
rounds.explanation: Teacher Yasmin names the project in her first speech of the story.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Choose the word that fits: The wall was weak, ______ we added more stones.
rounds.explanation: Adding stones is the result of the weak wall, and a result takes so after the comma.

rounds.prompt: In Helping Hands, what did Nora offer to do?
choices: Paint some birds on the wall.
rounds.explanation: Nora asks her question the moment she sees Omar struggling with the basket.

rounds.prompt: Which verb means to grow or become better over time?
rounds.explanation: Develop describes slow change, which is why a town or a skill can develop.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: What does the word protect mean in this unit?
choices: To look carefully for something you have lost.
To finish a job so that nothing is left over.
To keep someone or something safe from harm.
To go from one place to another far away.
rounds.answer: To keep someone or something safe from harm.
rounds.explanation: Protect is about safety, so the helmet in the example sentence keeps your head from harm.

rounds.prompt: In The Wall Behind the Garden, what did the class remove before they could build?
rounds.explanation: Teacher Yasmin says the broken fence must go first, before any building starts.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses the past simple correctly?
choices: Yesterday they are build a house.
rounds.explanation: The time word yesterday shows the action is finished, and the past form of build is built.
